front.title: PSI-02: Receipts for Carbon Sequestration Measurement Records

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-02, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for measurement records supporting carbon sequestration claims, such as field sampling results, remote-sensing extracts, and calculation inputs. Each record is sealed as a PSI receipt so that later alteration, reordering, or removal is detectable. Only digests are sealed. PSI-02 shows integrity and ordering only; it does not show that the sequestration occurred, that a methodology was followed, or that any credit is valid.
Revision 00 carried this title over an abstract describing disability-services evidence. This revision makes the body match the title.
